Licences of the voice-activity files in this folder
===================================================

These files are shipped unmodified from the npm packages @ricky0123/vad-web
and onnxruntime-web. They are not covered by Avatar Companion's own licence.

                                https://github.com/ricky0123/vad

                                https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs    onnxruntime-web, MIT
  ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm   https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

                                built with. Their notices are in
                                ThirdPartyNotices.txt, beside this file. One of
                                them, Eigen, is under the Mozilla Public License
                                2.0; its source is at
                                https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen
